# Pricing Evidence

Use the read-only ARM pricing path for current candidate comparison. Match the region, operating system, licensing,
reservation term, meter, currency, and quantity before comparing prices.

VMSS does not add a separate compute charge: compare the selected VM price multiplied by the accepted capacity model.
Do not present a unit price as a monthly cost without recording the calculation basis and expected runtime.

A recommendation must state the evidence retrieval time, query scope, candidate SKU, price basis, commitment
assumption, quantity, and uncertainty. Pricing evidence informs cost trade-offs; it does not choose a SKU, prove quota,
or authorize procurement.
